thag2.16:1.1:
This swarthy woman
[preparing a corpse for cremation]
—crow-like, enormous—
thag2.16:1.2:
breaking a thigh & then the other
thigh,
thag2.16:1.3:
breaking an arm & then the other
arm,
thag2.16:1.4:
cracking open the head,
like a pot of curds,
thag2.16:1.5: she sits with them heaped up beside her.
thag2.16:2.2:
—the fool—
returns over & over
to suffering & stress.
thag2.16:2.4:
May I never lie
with my head cracked open
again.
